summary: ElevenLabs TTS migration verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass on mobile viewport 390x844 (~10s). POST /api/tts/generate returns valid mp3 for putri/lilis/parjo/bagas via eleven_multilingual_v2 with 4 DISTINCT sha256 cache keys (voice_ids: EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL / JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb / TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ / Xb7hH8MSUJpSbSDYk0k2). GET /api/tts/{key}.mp3 serves audio/mpeg with non-empty bytes (>500B) and Cache-Control 1yr. Idempotent caching, unknown key -> 404, empty/whitespace text -> 400. Long Indonesian sentence 'Pembayaran lima puluh ribu rupiah berhasil, terima kasih' generates successfully for all 4 voices. Frontend: 29/29 UI checks pass. Home hero shows new barista background image + QRIS Aja logo + 'Selamat pagi, Agus 👋' stacked left (no crash, image renders). Profil -> Suara pembayaran opens with 4 voice cards + photo avatars; Kak Putri is default (checkmark + 'Default' badge). Tapping test-voice-lilis toggles label to 'Memutar' with spinner; only one plays at a time; reverts to 'Tes' after playback. Selecting voice-lilis moves the checkmark to Teh Lilis. Volume segments vol-Pelan/Sedang/Keras selectable; toggle-repeat and toggle-autosim work. Both intro & outro sections show 'maks 3 detik' label; pick-intro/record-intro/pick-outro/record-outro render and are interactive. preview-sound and test-payment-settings both fire; test payment adds a transaction visible in Riwayat. No red-screen errors, no pageerror events. Pre-existing deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) unchanged and non-blocking.

Deprecated shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset used across multiple style blocks; migrate to boxShadow for RN Web while keeping native compatibility. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (styles.outletPill, balanceCard, actionTile, badge, badgeInner, fab).

action_items: Optional cleanup (carry-over): replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (RN Web) and pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents on Toast.
No blocking issues detected for this ElevenLabs migration round.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly switched to elevenlabs client with eleven_multilingual_v2; EL_VOICE_MAP has 4 distinct voice_ids for lilis/parjo/bagas/putri and legacy pria/wanita aliases retained; cache key = sha256(text|voice_id|model) so migration invalidated old OpenAI cache (expected) and new keys are distinct per voice (confirmed by test_distinct_voices_produce_distinct_keys).
Unused import remains: `from emergentintegrations.llm.openai import OpenAITextToSpeech` — safe to remove (minor cleanup, non-blocking).
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY read via os.environ.get() at import time and passed to ElevenLabs(); consider validating presence at startup with a clear error if missing (currently would fail on first request).
Response uses base64 store in Mongo (tts_audio collection) with Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000; no MongoDB _id leakage in either endpoint.
Frontend index.tsx renders HEADER_BG image absolutely filling the hero and stacks QRIS Aja logo + welcome text on top — verified visually. LOGO uses uri source; heroBg local asset.

CHAR_IMG static require() mapping intact; per-character test button correctly toggles between <ActivityIndicator/> 'Memutar' and <Icon 'play'/> 'Tes' driven by playingVoice state; only one plays at a time as observed.

'maks 3 detik' constraint is enforced by paymentSound helpers (import path /app/frontend/src/audio/paymentSound.ts) and the label 'Audio intro (maks 3 detik)' / 'Audio outro (maks 3 detik)' is present in the UI.
Uses expo-audio (not deprecated expo-av); no deprecated Expo packages detected.
